title: New demo toast copy breaks the sibling pattern established in the same file
evidence:
+pub const demo_bulk_invite_toast: String = "Demo mode - invites are not sent."

(siblings in the same hunk: pub const demo_payments_toast: String = "Payments aren't part of the demo. Create your own vacancy to unlock AI analysis." / pub const demo_settings_profile_toast: String = "Settings aren't part of the demo. Sign up to manage your real profile.")
detail: Every neighboring demo toast reads "X aren't part of the demo. <next action>." The new copy uses a debug-style "Demo mode - " prefix, the non-contracted "are not", and offers no guidance on what to do instead.
recommended_fix: Rephrase to match siblings, e.g. "Invites aren't part of the demo. Sign up to send real invitations." — contraction, sentence structure, and a next action.

title: Empty-emails submit is swallowed with zero feedback
detail: The toast is now the only feedback this button can ever produce in demo mode, yet an empty (or whitespace-only, if trimmed upstream) textarea click returns effect.none() — the user cannot tell the demo intercepted anything. Untested arm, too.
recommended_fix: Route the empty case through the same demo notice toast, or confirm the submit control is disabled when the field is empty; add a test for the empty arm either way.
